title: Decision Ledger for Company OKRs — Roadmap Synchronization and Cross-Functional Escalation
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Establish a lightweight, auditable Decision Ledger and operational protocol to ensure every company-level OKR maps to a clearly prioritized initiative in the roadmap, appropriate owners, and a cross-functional escalation path. This ticket covers the first delivery: a documented process, a canonical Google Drive Decision Ledger template, two pilot alignment sessions (Infra + Product and Console + Sales), and a small UI in the Console roadmap view that surfaces OKR-to-initiative mappings for exec reviews.
background: Over the last three quarters we observed drift between stated company OKRs and the initiatives tracked in team roadmaps. That causes misallocated engineering effort and inconsistent stakeholder expectations. Previous playbooks focused on cadence but left decision provenance and escalation rules underspecified. This work creates a single place (Decision Ledger) where every cross-functional alignment decision is recorded, rationale captured, trade-offs enumerated, and follow-ups assigned.
scope: In-scope: Decision Ledger template, alignment meeting cadence, acceptance criteria, pilot with two cross-functional pods, links from ledger entries to roadmap items, and a lightweight Console roadmap widget to surface mappings. Out-of-scope: Full automation of ledger creation from tickets, org-wide rollout beyond pilots, and long-term data warehousing of ledger entries (future phase).
acceptance_criteria: A documented Decision Ledger template stored in Drive with fields: decision id, date, participants, OKR(s) affected, initiative(s) affected, decision rationale, alternatives considered, metrics to track, owner, follow-ups, and review cadence.
Two pilot alignment sessions completed with notes recorded in the Decision Ledger and linked to the corresponding roadmap entries (Infra + Product pilot and Console + Sales pilot).
Console roadmap view prototype that can display OKR-to-initiative mappings for an exec reviewer; prototype tested in one stakeholder review meeting.
Escalation matrix defined (when to escalate, to whom, SLA for response) and published to the org handbook.
A short runbook for PMs describing how to use the ledger during planning and weekly syncs.
Three sample decisions in the ledger include measurable follow-ups and assigned owners with due dates.

risks: Low adoption if ledger adds too much ceremony — mitigated by 1-page template and PM training.
Confusion over primary owner for initiatives that touch multiple orgs — mitigated by explicit RACI in each decision entry.
Timing mismatch with quarterly planning windows — mitigate by aligning pilot cadence to current cycle and offering retro windows.
Console widget scope creep — prototype limited to read-only surface for exec review only in pilot.
